snippet.title: JungleTac 16-in-1 - Rapid Stream (GBA)
snippet.description: Here is the fifth game from the JungleTac 16-in-1 multicart. This one seems to rip off In The Hunt, which is better than this game. This is very frustrating and very boring. It also rips sprites from Metal Slug and from Donkey Kong Country
